full_list.title_en: Mn-deficient Ni-Mn-Ga alloys: phase transitions, magnetic properties, and disappearance of martensitic transformation
full_list.title_zh: 缺锰 Ni-Mn-Ga 合金：相变、磁性能和马氏体转变消失
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31206v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Composition gradients formed during directional solidification are generally considered undesirable in Ni-Mn-Ga magnetic shape-memory alloys. However, these gradients offer a highly effective platform for systematically investigating composition-property relationships under identical growth and heat-treatment conditions. To exploit this approach, one Mn-deficient and two near-stoichiometric Ni-Mn-Ga oligocrystals were grown by optical zone remelting and characterized by X-ray fluorescence mapping, optical microscopy, X-ray diffraction, low-field magnetic measurements, and vibrating-sample magnetometry. The ingots contained elongated grains and axial compositional gradients, primarily associated with the redistribution of Mn and Ga, whereas Ni remained relatively uniformly distributed. The martensitic and premartensitic transformation temperatures generally increased with increasing Mn content. Neither transformation was detected between 10 and 400 K in specimens containing 20.5-22.0 at.% Mn, all of which had e/a < 7.40. In contrast, both transformations were observed in the investigated specimens containing at least 22.1 at.% (e/a ≥ 7.46). This abrupt change may indicate a possible electron-concentration threshold for the occurrence of these transformations. Saturation magnetization increased with Mn content up to 25.8 at.%, reaching 96.9 A m²/kg at 10 K and 71.2 A m²/kg at 300 K. Post-growth annealing increased the transition temperatures and changed the low-field magnetic response. The results indicate that composition-gradient oligocrystals serve as an effective platform for investigating the relationships between composition, structure, and magnetic properties in Ni-Mn-Ga alloys with the same processing history.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在 Ni-Mn-Ga 磁性形状记忆合金中，定向凝固过程中形成的成分梯度通常被认为是不受欢迎的。然而，这些梯度为系统地研究相同生长和热处理条件下的成分-性能关系提供了一个高效的平台。为了利用这种方法，通过光学区域重熔生长了一种缺锰和两种接近化学计量的 Ni-Mn-Ga 寡晶，并通过 X 射线荧光测绘、光学显微镜、X 射线衍射、低场磁测量和振动样品磁力测定进行了表征。铸锭含有细长晶粒和轴向成分梯度，主要与锰和镓的重新分布有关，而镍则保持相对均匀的分布。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在 Ni-Mn-Ga 磁性形状记忆合金中，定向凝固过程中形成的成分梯度通常被认为是不受欢迎的。然而，这些梯度为系统地研究相同生长和热处理条件下的成分-性能关系提供了一个高效的平台。为了利用这种方法，通过光学区域重熔生长了一种缺锰和两种接近化学计量的 Ni-Mn-Ga 寡晶，并通过 X 射线荧光测绘、光学显微镜、X 射线衍射、低场磁测量和振动样品磁力测定进行了表征。铸锭含有细长晶粒和轴向成分梯度，主要与锰和镓的重新分布有关，而镍则保持相对均匀的分布。马氏体和预马氏体转变温度通常随着锰含量的增加而增加。在含有 20.5-22.0 at.% Mn 的样品中，在 10 到 400 K 之间均未检测到任何转变，所有样品的 e/a < 7.40。相比之下，在所研究的至少含有 22.1 at.% (e/a ≥ 7.46) 的样品中观察到这两种转变。这种突然的变化可能表明发生这些转变的可能的电子浓度阈值。饱和磁化强度随 Mn 含量增加至 25.8 at.% 而增加，在 10 K 时达到 96.9 A m²/kg，在 300 K 时达到 71.2 A m²/kg。生长后退火提高了转变温度并改变了低场磁响应。结果表明，成分梯度寡晶是研究具有相同加工历史的 Ni-Mn-Ga 合金成分、结构和磁性能之间关系的有效平台。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《缺锰 Ni-Mn-Ga 合金：相变、磁性能和马氏体转变消失》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Nature of the bosonic edge phase in a double quantum spin Hall insulator
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Nature of the bosonic edge phase in a double quantum spin Hall insulator
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30251v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Field-theoretic analysis has predicted that the edge of a double quantum spin Hall insulator (DQSHI) can undergo an interaction-driven transition from a phase with fermionic edge modes into one with only bosonic modes. All single-fermion edge excitations are gapped in this bosonic edge phase, but fermion pairs remain gapless, leading to distinct experimental signatures. We numerically simulate the interacting DQSHI edge and verify the existence of the bosonic edge phase. This calculation requires an explicit bulk embedding of the DQSHI edge, due to its mixed anomaly between charge and S^z conservation. We hence employ segment DMRG on an infinite two-dimensional cylinder, where the DQSHI bulk is modeled in terms of two copies of the spin-up lowest Landau level, combined with their time-reversed counterparts. We find that interactions can open a single-fermion gap at the DQSHI edge while fermion pairs remain gapless, matching the predictions for the bosonic edge phase. We find the scaling of the single-fermion gap with interaction strength to be consistent with field-theoretic calculations, and discuss the relevance of the bosonic edge phase to twisted homobilayers of WSe₂ and MoTe₂. We elaborate on the methodological extension of the segment geometry used here to other topological phases with edge anomalies.

full_list.title_en: Nitrogen vacancy cluster-mediated ferroelectric domain growth in wurtzite AlN
full_list.title_zh: 氮空位簇介导的纤锌矿 AlN 中铁电畴的生长
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31084v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Aluminum nitride-based ferroelectrics combine high remanent polarization, thermal stability, weak size effects, a wide bandgap and back-end process compatibility, making them promising for high density non-volatile memory. However, their high coercive field (E_c) and unclear polarization switching mechanism limit further applications. Theoretical predictions indicate preferential reversed domain growth along the polar axis, whereas experiments show nearly isotropic growth or preferential growth perpendicular to this axis. Here, we combine density functional theory, Deep Potential molecular dynamics and experimental characterization to determine how nitrogen vacancies (V_N) regulate domain growth and E_c. In ideal crystal, strong lattice coupling along the polar axis drives preferential domain growth in this direction. V_N locally weakens this coupling and promotes polarization nucleation. The spatial distribution of V_N and the temporal sequence of vacancy induced switching jointly determine the direction and morphology of reversed domain growth. We further show that scandium doping promotes V_N formation, thereby enhancing defect mediated nucleation and reducing E_c. These findings establish a multiscale mechanism governing thin-film domain-growth kinetics and macroscopic E_c, reconciling experimental observations with ideal crystal simulations and providing defect engineering principles for low-voltage, reliable and scalable ferroelectric devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 氮化铝基铁电体结合了高剩余极化、热稳定性、弱尺寸效应、宽带隙和后端工艺兼容性，使其有望用于高密度非易失性存储器。然而，它们的高矫顽场（E_c）和不清楚的偏振切换机制限制了进一步的应用。理论预测表明沿极轴优先反向域生长，而实验显示近各向同性生长或垂直于该轴的优先生长。在这里，我们结合密度泛函理论、深势分子动力学和实验表征来确定氮空位 (V_N) 如何调节域生长和 E_c。在理想晶体中，沿极轴的强晶格耦合驱动沿该方向的择优生长。 V_N 局部削弱了这种耦合并促进极化成核。

full_list.title_en: Piezo-Kerr effect in altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets
full_list.title_zh: 交流磁体和非共线反铁磁体中的压电克尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30929v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Symmetry is usually viewed as a constraint on physical responses, but it can also be used to design the fields that control them. Here, we adopt the representation-matching principle used to identify conjugate fields of order parameters and apply it to response tensors. A linear coupling, the key ingredient for sign-switching control, is symmetry-allowed when a component (or a combination of components) of the control field and the selected response component share the same irreducible representation of the magnetic point group (MPG) of the system. Applied to the magneto-optical Kerr effect, this principle yields a piezo-Kerr effect, in which specific strain combinations activate a Kerr response forbidden in the unstrained state. Enumerating all 122 MPGs, we identify 16 groups in which the unstrained Kerr response is forbidden while a linear strain-induced contribution is allowed. These groups are realized by altermagnets and noncollinear antiferromagnets with symmetry-enforced vanishing net magnetization. The active strain channels and the associated first-order sign reversals follow directly from symmetry. First-principles calculations for bulk MnTe₂ and CoF₂, and Cr₂Se₂O and Cr₂Te₂O monolayers confirm these predictions. In these materials, the Kerr rotation vanishes without strain, whereas 0.5-3% strain produces rotations ranging from tens to hundreds of millidegrees, and reversing the matched strain channel reverses the Kerr sign. These results establish a general route to large and switchable Kerr responses emerging from symmetry-forbidden states in compensated magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对称性通常被视为对物理响应的约束，但它也可以用于设计控制它们的场。在这里，我们采用表示匹配原理来识别阶次参数的共轭场并将其应用于响应张量。当控制场的一个分量（或分量的组合）和选定的响应分量共享系统磁点组（MPG）的相同不可约表示时，线性耦合是符号切换控制的关键要素，是允许对称的。应用于磁光克尔效应时，该原理会产生压电克尔效应，其中特定的应变组合激活在无应变状态下禁止的克尔响应。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《交流磁体和非共线反铁磁体中的压电克尔效应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Strain-induced structural transformations in hexagonal monolayer boron nitride. A density functional study
full_list.title_zh: 六方单层氮化硼中应变诱导的结构转变。密度泛函研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work we theoretically study the structural transformations occurring in monolayer hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) subjected to strong deformations. The first-principle computer simulations are based on the density functional theory employing the pseudopotentials with the exchange-correlation energy given in Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof form. Depending on the direction and the type of the strain, the simulations reveal different types of structural transformations in two-dimensional (2D) h-BN associated with the elastic failure. It is found that, under certain shear strains, there can form an ordered 2D orthorhombic phase with the 2D layer space symmetry pmmm. Thermal stability of the latter up to ~900 K is demonstrated by first-principle Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics. The examination of electronic structure indicates that, in contrast to the conventional h-BN, which is an insulator with the wide band gap, the predicted orthorhombic phase is expected to be a semiconductor with the narrow band gap of ~ 0.65 eV.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们从理论上研究了单层六方氮化硼（h-BN）在强烈变形下发生的结构转变。第一原理计算机模拟基于密度泛函理论，采用赝势以及以 Perdew-Burke-Ernzerhof 形式给出的交换相关能量。根据应变的方向和类型，模拟揭示了与弹性失效相关的二维 (2D) h-BN 中不同类型的结构转变。研究发现，在一定的剪切应变下，可以形成二维层空间对称性pmmm的有序二维斜方相。第一原理 Born-Oppenheimer 分子动力学证明了后者高达约 900 K 的热稳定性。

full_list.title_en: The ideal limit of rhombohedral graphene: Dynamical skyrmion lattices and their excitations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：The ideal limit of rhombohedral graphene: Dynamical skyrmion lattices and their excitations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.07402v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce an interacting ideal limit of rhombohedral graphene in which interactions spontaneously generate a correlated Chern insulator. Our analysis reveals that this Chern insulator can be understood as a layer-pseudospin skyrmion lattice stabilized by electronic interactions, and that it gives rise to genuine skyrmion lattice physics, complete with dynamics. This dynamical skyrmion lattice naturally leads to experimentally measurable consequences. In particular, we identify new collective excitations corresponding to chiral shape deformations of the skyrmions, and propose a new positively charged quasiparticle, the skyrmion vacancy. These results establish a qualitatively new form of moiré Chern physics in rhombohedral graphene: an interaction-generated skyrmion lattice whose skyrmions are dynamical low-energy degrees of freedom.

full_list.title_en: Dipole-exchange spin waves and mode hybridization in magnetic nanoparticles
full_list.title_zh: 磁性纳米粒子中的偶极子交换自旋波和模式杂交
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.24187v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate spin-wave modes in confined ferromagnetic resonators with spherical and cylindrical geometries across the exchange-dominated, dipole-exchange, and dipolar interaction regimes. Starting from the linearized Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation, we show that the projection of the total angular momentum and mirror parity are conserved quantities in the problem of axially symmetric resonators. These symmetries provide a natural classification of spin-wave modes and explain the degeneracy of exchange modes, as well as its lifting by dipolar interactions. Numerical analysis shows that the nonlocal dipolar interaction removes the exchange degeneracy and hybridizes modes, leading to avoided crossings between modes that belong to the same symmetry sector. To describe this behavior, we develop a coupled-mode theory formulated directly in terms of dynamical magnetization, which reduces the dipole-exchange problem to a finite system of interacting modes. The resulting framework provides a unified description of spin-wave spectra in confined magnetic particles from the exchange limit to the dipolar regime.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了交换主导、偶极交换和偶极相互作用状态下具有球形和圆柱形几何形状的受限铁磁谐振器中的自旋波模式。从线性化的Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert方程出发，我们证明总角动量的投影和镜宇称在轴对称谐振器问题中是守恒量。这些对称性提供了自旋波模式的自然分类，并解释了交换模式的简并性及其通过偶极相互作用的提升。数值分析表明，非局域偶极相互作用消除了交换简并并使模式混合，从而避免了属于同一对称扇区的模式之间的交叉。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《磁性纳米粒子中的偶极子交换自旋波和模式杂交》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Lattice dynamics and structural correlations in antiferromagnet SrLaCoNbO₆ double perovskite
full_list.title_zh: 反铁磁体 SrLaCoNbO₆ 双钙钛矿的晶格动力学和结构相关性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2607.07630v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a detailed temperature-dependent Raman spectroscopy and Co K-edge extended x-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) study of the insulating antiferromagnetic double perovskite SrLaCoNbO₆. Interestingly, pronounced changes in the phonon frequencies, linewidths, and intensities are observed around 60~K, well above the long-range antiferromagnetic ordering temperature, Tᵣₘ N approx 15~K. These anomalies indicate a modification of the lattice dynamics that may involve local structural distortions, short-range magnetic correlations, or an interplay between them. Additional changes in both high- and low-energy Raman modes are detected near 160--180~K via variations in phonon intensities and linewidths, together with changes in the Fano asymmetry of selected low-energy modes. The asymmetric line shapes of these modes are well described phenomenologically by Fano profiles and indicate coupling of the discrete phonons to an underlying continuum, whose possible microscopic origins are discussed. Moreover, the EXAFS analysis reveals correlated changes in bond distances and Debye--Waller factors around the Co ions near 60~K and 160~K, indicating subtle local structural distortions at temperatures corresponding to the Raman anomalies. The combined Raman and EXAFS results therefore demonstrate a close correlation between anomalous lattice dynamics and local structural evolution in SrLaCoNbO₆.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了绝缘反铁磁双钙钛矿 SrLaCoNbO₆ 的详细温度依赖性拉曼光谱和 Co K 边扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 研究。有趣的是，在 60~K 左右观察到声子频率、线宽和强度的显着变化，远高于长程反铁磁有序温度 Tᵣₘ N 约 15~K。这些异常表明晶格动力学发生了变化，可能涉及局部结构畸变、短程磁关联或它们之间的相互作用。通过声子强度和线宽的变化，以及所选低能模式的法诺不对称性的变化，在 160--180~K 附近检测到高能和低能拉曼模式的额外变化。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了绝缘反铁磁双钙钛矿 SrLaCoNbO₆ 的详细温度依赖性拉曼光谱和 Co K 边扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 研究。有趣的是，在 60~K 左右观察到声子频率、线宽和强度的显着变化，远高于长程反铁磁有序温度 Tᵣₘ N 约 15~K。这些异常表明晶格动力学发生了变化，可能涉及局部结构畸变、短程磁关联或它们之间的相互作用。通过声子强度和线宽的变化，以及所选低能模式的法诺不对称性的变化，在 160--180~K 附近检测到高能和低能拉曼模式的额外变化。 Fano 轮廓在现象学上很好地描述了这些模式的不对称线形状，并表明离散声子与底层连续体的耦合，并讨论了其可能的微观起源。此外，EXAFS 分析揭示了在 60~K 和 160~K 附近 Co 离子周围键距和 Debye-Waller 因子的相关变化，表明在与拉曼异常相对应的温度下存在微妙的局部结构扭曲。因此，拉曼和 EXAFS 的组合结果证明了 SrLaCoNbO₆ 中的反常晶格动力学与局部结构演化之间存在密切相关性。

full_list.title_en: Ligand-mediated Origin of Altermagnetic Spin-Splitting
full_list.title_zh: 配体介导的交变磁自旋分裂的起源
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.21284v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Altermagnets host spin-split electronic bands despite zero net magnetization, opening new routes for spintronics beyond conventional ferromagnets. Going beyond symmetry-based classifications, which specify allowed terms but not their hierarchy, here we use first-principles calculations and Wannier Hamiltonian engineering to uncover the microscopic bonding contributions of altermagnetic spin splitting in the g-wave altermagnet Co₁/₄NbSe₂. We show that the splitting is captured by a short-range tight-binding model, establishing its local origin. By selectively controlling hopping channels, we demonstrate that the dominant contribution arises not from direct magnetic-ion hopping, but from ligand-mediated hybridization that transfers anisotropy to itinerant states. This identifies ligand-assisted coupling as the key mechanism of altermagnetic spin splitting and provides a microscopic bridge between minimal models and symmetry guided first-principles material searches, enabling real-space design of altermagnetic functionality.
full_list.abstract_zh: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交替磁体仍具有自旋分裂电子能带，这为自旋电子学开辟了超越传统铁磁体的新途径。超越基于对称的分类（指定允许的术语但不指定其层次结构），这里我们使用第一原理计算和 Wannier Hamiltonian 工程来揭示 g 波交变磁体 Co₁/₄NbSe2 中交变磁自旋分裂的微观键合贡献。我们表明，分裂是由短程紧束缚模型捕获的，建立了其局部起源。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交替磁体仍具有自旋分裂电子能带，这为自旋电子学开辟了超越传统铁磁体的新途径。超越基于对称的分类（指定允许的术语但不指定其层次结构），这里我们使用第一原理计算和 Wannier Hamiltonian 工程来揭示 g 波交变磁体 Co₁/₄NbSe2 中交变磁自旋分裂的微观键合贡献。我们表明，分裂是由短程紧束缚模型捕获的，建立了其局部起源。通过选择性控制跳跃通道，我们证明主要贡献不是来自直接磁离子跳跃，而是来自配体介导的杂交，该杂交将各向异性转移到流动状态。这将配体辅助耦合确定为交变磁自旋分裂的关键机制，并在最小模型和对称引导第一原理材料搜索之间提供了微观桥梁，从而实现了交变磁功能的实空间设计。

full_list.title_en: Selective strain tuning of nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics in BiFeO_text3
full_list.title_zh: BiFeO_text3 中非平衡多铁动力学的选择性应变调谐
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.29472v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum materials are characterized by intertwined orders, and a fundamental goal in condensed matter physics is to achieve their selective control in such a way that one order parameter can be tuned while leaving others largely unaffected. Although significant progress has been made in thermal equilibrium, realizing such control out of equilibrium remains highly challenging. Here we employed in-situ tensile strain to selectively manipulate the photoinduced lattice dynamics associated with ferroelectric and magnetic orders in multiferroic BiFeO₃. By applying MeV ultrafast electron diffraction to freestanding BiFeO₃ membranes under tunable strain, we showed that tensile strain markedly suppresses the ultrafast photoinduced reduction of the ferroelectric displacement. By contrast, the photoinduced dynamics of the antiferrodistortive rotation of the oxygen octahedra, which modulates the magnetic order, remains insensitive to strain. Not only do these findings reveal distinct microscopic pathways underlying nonequilibrium multiferroic dynamics, they also establish tunable strain as an effective route for engineering ultrafast phase control in correlated materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 量子材料的特点是相互交织的秩序，凝聚态物理的一个基本目标是实现其选择性控制，从而可以调整一个秩序参数，同时使其他秩序参数基本上不受影响。尽管在热平衡方面已经取得了重大进展，但实现这种不平衡控制仍然极具挑战性。在这里，我们采用原位拉伸应变来选择性地操纵与多铁性 BiFeO₃ 中的铁电和磁序相关的光致晶格动力学。通过在可调应变下对独立式 BiFeO₃ 膜应用 MeV 超快电子衍射，我们发现拉伸应变显着抑制了铁电位移的超快光致减少。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 量子材料的特点是相互交织的秩序，凝聚态物理的一个基本目标是实现其选择性控制，从而可以调整一个秩序参数，同时使其他秩序参数基本上不受影响。尽管在热平衡方面已经取得了重大进展，但实现这种不平衡控制仍然极具挑战性。在这里，我们采用原位拉伸应变来选择性地操纵与多铁性 BiFeO₃ 中的铁电和磁序相关的光致晶格动力学。通过在可调应变下对独立式 BiFeO₃ 膜应用 MeV 超快电子衍射，我们发现拉伸应变显着抑制了铁电位移的超快光致减少。相比之下，调节磁序的氧八面体反铁畸变旋转的光致动力学仍然对应变不敏感。这些发现不仅揭示了非平衡多铁动力学背后的独特微观途径，而且还确立了可调谐应变作为相关材料中工程超快相位控制的有效途径。

full_list.title_en: What Becomes of the Antiferromagnetic String When Long Range Neel Order Is Lost? Exact Results
full_list.title_zh: 当长程尼尔阶丢失时，反铁磁弦会发生什么？确切的结果
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.30346v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Early string descriptions of doped antiferromagnets associate hole motion in a locally Néel-ordered background with a path-dependent antiferromagnetic string. We ask what becomes of this mechanism when long range Néel order is lost while short range antiferromagnetic correlations persist. In a singlet bond representation, the underlying basis states do not assign an oriented (A/B) spin registration to each bond. Therefore, any surviving long wavelength antiferromagnetic axis is naturally described as a director, (mathbf nsim-mathbf n). Long range Néel order can nevertheless provide a global (S²) lift of this director field; when that long range registration is lost, non liftable configurations of the (RP²) manifold become physically accessible, opening a topologically nontrivial (mathbb Z₂) sector. Its elementary defects are half vortices that globally minimize the (RP²) (σ)-model energy within the nontrivial (mathbb Z₂) sector. An a posteriori energetic comparison further shows that the projective half vortex texture is softer than the corresponding vector reference texture. A pair of half vortices with opposite windings is logarithmically confined, (V(R) = κ lnleft(R/rcₒᵣₑright)), (κ = π ρₛ /2). The resulting confinement is carried not by a one dimensional string but by an extended two-dimensional spin texture. Thus, the loss of long-range Néel order does not eliminate antiferromagnetic confinement but removes the global Néel lift. This activates a distinct projective mechanism in which a local path dependent string is replaced, at long wavelengths, by a global topological texture with logarithmic confinement.
full_list.abstract_zh: 早期对掺杂反铁磁体的弦描述将局部尼尔有序背景中的空穴运动与路径相关的反铁磁弦联系起来。我们要问的是，当长程尼尔序丢失而短程反铁磁相关性仍然存在时，这种机制会发生什么。在单态键表示中，基础基态不会为每个键分配定向 (A/B) 自旋配准。因此，任何幸存的长波长反铁磁轴自然被描述为指向矢（mathbf nsim-mathbf n）。尽管如此，长程尼尔阶仍可以提供该导向场的全局（S²）提升；

full_list.title_en: Anomalous Thermal Conductivity Reversal Driven by a Fluctuating Charge Density Wave
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anomalous Thermal Conductivity Reversal Driven by a Fluctuating Charge Density Wave
full_list.abstract: For more than a century, the lattice thermal conductivity of crystalline solids has been known to decrease with increasing temperature, as the phonons that carry heat scatter more strongly via Umklapp processes. Here we report a pronounced violation of this rule in the layered charge-density-wave (CDW) metal 2H-TaSe₂. Its in-plane thermal conductivity is strongly nonmonotonic: it peaks sharply at the 122 K ordering transition, collapses to a deep minimum near 210 K, and then anomalously reverses, rising with temperature to at least 350 K. Such a high-temperature reversal, in which a crystal conducts heat more efficiently as it is heated, is rare in crystalline solids. Its thermal conductivity minimum lies deep in the disordered phase well above the ordering transition, unlike the weak, transition-centered anomalies of other charge-density-wave systems, pointing to heat conduction governed by fluctuating rather than established order. Combining inelastic X-ray scattering, selected-area electron diffraction, and synchrotron X-ray diffraction, we attribute the reversal to phonons scattering off persistent, fluctuating charge order that survives more than 150 K above the long-range transition, to at least 300 K. A phenomenological phonon–CDW scattering model, tied directly to the measured diffraction linewidth and intensity, quantitatively reproduces the entire nonmonotonic curve. We also reveal that the charge order melts not abruptly but through a fluctuation- and defect-driven, weak first-order process, leaving short-range correlations far above the transition. This work establishes fluctuating charge order as a sensitive control knob for thermal transport in quantum materials and thermal conductivity as a powerful probe of the hidden charge order.

full_list.title_en: Automated generation and execution of large-scale semidefinite programs for variational two-electron reduced density matrix theory
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Automated generation and execution of large-scale semidefinite programs for variational two-electron reduced density matrix theory
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The variational two-electron reduced density matrix (v2RDM) method provides a wave-function-free approach to the description of strong electron correlation whose computational cost scales polynomially with the number of correlated orbitals. Here, we present an automated pipeline for the generation and execution of semidefinite programs (SDPs) associated with the v2RDM problem. Algebraic constraints encoding ensemble N-representability conditions are generated via the p^daggerq second-quantized algebra package, and the p^daggerq-generated expressions are automatically translated into a sparse-matrix representation that can be digested by an appropriate SDP solver. We have implemented a boundary-point SDP (BPSDP) solver in the libsdp package that can execute the v2RDM SDPs on either CPU or GPU hardware. We apply the code in several contexts. First, two-particle conditions are used to describe the 76-orbital model of the iron-molybdenum cofactor (FeMoco) of nitrogenase, the simulation of which requires roughly 25 hours of compute time on a single Nvidia H100 GPU. Second, the performance of high-order (four-particle positivity) conditions is evaluated on a challenging two-dimensional H₁₀ cluster problem. Lastly, new classes of positivity constraints for mixed fermion-boson systems are generated and applied within the context of ab initio cavity quantum electrodynamics simulations.

full_list.title_en: Near Chemical Accuracy From Size-Consistent Padé Resummed Møller-Plesset Perturbation Theory
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Near Chemical Accuracy From Size-Consistent Padé Resummed Møller-Plesset Perturbation Theory
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.25330v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Padé resummation of the correlation energy from Møller-Plesset (MP) perturbation theory is not size-consistent and is therefore seldom used. We present an orbital-based Padé resummation of the MP2 and MP3 self-energy operators, whose trace yields a size-consistent correlation energy. We find that damping the third-order same-spin contribution leads to substantially increased accuracy, with the resulting same-spin damped orbital Padé resummed (SSD-OPMP3) approach attaining near-chemical accuracy (mean absolute error sim 1 kcal/mol) for total atomization energies of non-multireference molecules in the W4-17 dataset against the gold standard CCSD(T) method. Excellent performance surpassing CCSD is also obtained for other molecular datasets such as those containing barrier heights, noncovalent interactions, dipole moments, static polarizabilities, and transition-metal chemistry. full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30271v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We discuss phases of interacting fermionic Luttinger liquids without particle number conservation, such as those in proximity to a superconductor, subjected to weak continuous measurements of their particle density, in the regime where the bosonization approach is applicable. We show that the phases of these systems are controlled by the competition between measurements, which favor the area-law phase and particle tunneling in and out of the Luttinger liquid, which favors the volume-law phase. The volume-law phase in this system is always charge fuzzy. We show that within this framework, the phase boundary between the two phases is given by a universal dependence of the Luttinger parameter on the measurement rate. This behavior can be contrasted with the non-universal phase boundaries in more generic highly excited one dimensional systems whose behavior is no longer captured by the Luttinger liquid framework.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show how a gyrotropic cavity vacuum generates, probes, and spatially programs non-Abelian topology in the Kitaev honeycomb model. Gauge-consistent virtual-photon elimination produces a universal helicity-odd interaction i[Pₓ,P_y] alongside same-order even dressing. For the leading bond polarization, this commutator is exactly the Kitaev three-spin mass. Mode normalization imposes a thermodynamic constraint: one extended normalized mode gives a local mass that vanishes with sample area, whereas a localized mode writes a finite topological island and a finite mode density enables a bulk mass. The exact Majorana solution yields helicity-reversed Chern gaps and edge propagation, while integrated circular dichroism exactly measures the mass generator, langlei[Pₓ,P_y]rangle=-sqrt3p²langle O₃rangle. Real-space calculations reveal a non-Abelian island and a helicity wall with two co-propagating Majorana modes. Uniform helicity reversal is a Dirac-mass quench with nᵣₘ ₑₓproptoτ_Q⁻¹, whereas moving a wall localizes the gap closing. The equilibrium vacuum kernel contains sum-frequency rather than resonant denominators. These results establish distinct criteria for local and bulk cavity-induced topology.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Chiroptical Valleytronic in SnSe
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30930v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometric properties of Bloch electrons play a central role in governing light-matter interactions and transport phenomena in solids. Here, we report quantum-geometric chiroptical selection rules that generate a helicity-dependent momentum-space population imbalance in the group-IV monochalcogenide SnSe. By combining time- and angle-resolved extreme-ultraviolet photoemission spectroscopy with ab initio real-time simulations of photoexcited carrier dynamics, we identify valley-selective excitation at opposite crystal momenta arising from the breaking of time-reversal symmetry under circularly polarized illumination. We theoretically demonstrate that the magnitude of valley circular dichroism is strongly constrained by crystal symmetry through its influence on the quantum geometric tensor, the key quantity underlying valley optical selection rules. The resulting chiroptically induced valley polarization decays on sub-picosecond timescales through intervalley scattering mediated by electron-phonon coupling. Furthermore, we show theoretically that the population imbalance between valleys at opposite momenta gives rise to a helicity-reversible transient photocurrent. These findings provide microscopic insight into how quantum geometry governs valley-selective light-matter interactions, valley polarization, and photocurrent generation in van der Waals materials exhibiting hidden and transient symmetry breaking.

full_list.title_en: Delta-Doped GeV⁻ in diamond with isotope resolvable optical spectra
full_list.title_zh: 金刚石中 Delta 掺杂 GeV⁻ 的同位素可分辨光谱
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30375v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Group IV color centers in diamond -- silicon, germanium, tin, and lead-vacancy centers -- are a promising platform for quantum networking. Typical Group-IV creation utilizes ion implantation during diamond growth that leaves the color centers with a broad depth distribution and damage-induced strain inhomogeneity. Deterministic placement and damage reduction in Group IV generation are essential for improving this platform. In this letter, we report on the localization of germanium-vacancy (GeV⁻) to a < 10 nm layer via the timed injection of GeH₄ during microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition. In this layer we have realized 17 ppm of Ge and a strain-free environment for the GeV⁻. Subsequent electron irradiation and annealing have generated a sheet density of 0.12 GeV⁻/μm². The minimal damage from color center generation mitigates spectral inhomogeneity and allows spectral resolution of isotopic clusters, with the best cluster having an inhomogeneous distribution of 2.14 GHz and an average linewidth of 47 ± 11 MHz. Our study gives insight into formation dynamics of GeV⁻ in delta-doped systems and estimates our vacancy to GeV⁻ yield to be ≥ 90%, establishing an athermal nearest-neighbor formation model. We further characterized the spin T₂^* and set a lower bound of 730 ns, limited by a paramagnetic defect.
full_list.abstract_zh: 钻石中的 IV 族色心——硅、锗、锡和铅空位中心——是一个有前途的量子网络平台。典型的 IV 族制造在钻石生长过程中利用离子注入，使色心具有较宽的深度分布和损伤引起的应变不均匀性。第四组生成中的确定性放置和损伤减少对于改进该平台至关重要。在这封信中，我们报告了在微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中通过定时注入 GeH₄ 将锗空位 (GeV⁻) 定位到 < 10 nm 的层。在这一层中，我们实现了 17 ppm 的 Ge 和 GeV⁻ 的无应变环境。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 钻石中的 IV 族色心——硅、锗、锡和铅空位中心——是一个有前途的量子网络平台。典型的 IV 族制造在钻石生长过程中利用离子注入，使色心具有较宽的深度分布和损伤引起的应变不均匀性。第四组生成中的确定性放置和损伤减少对于改进该平台至关重要。在这封信中，我们报告了在微波等离子体化学气相沉积过程中通过定时注入 GeH₄ 将锗空位 (GeV⁻) 定位到 < 10 nm 的层。在这一层中，我们实现了 17 ppm 的 Ge 和 GeV⁻ 的无应变环境。随后的电子辐照和退火产生了 0.12 GeV-/μm2 的片密度。色心生成造成的最小损害可减轻光谱不均匀性，并实现同位素簇的光谱分辨率，最佳簇具有 2.14 GHz 的不均匀分布和 47 ± 11 MHz 的平均线宽。我们的研究深入了解了 δ 掺杂系统中 GeV⁻ 的形成动力学，并估计空位到 GeV⁻ 的产率≥ 90%，建立了非热最近邻形成模型。我们进一步表征了自旋 T2^* 并设置了 730 ns 的下限，受顺磁缺陷的限制。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《金刚石中 Delta 掺杂 GeV⁻ 的同位素可分辨光谱》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Design of Nuclear and Magnetic Scattering Length Density Profiles
full_list.title_zh: 核和磁散射长度密度分布的设计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30416v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The scattering length density (SLD) profile of a sample can be deliberately designed to enhance the information of interest obtained from neutron reflectometry. Here, we demonstrate this approach using amorphous FeₓCoyAl₈Zr₂ thin films. Four samples, each comprising ten repetitions of an AlZr spacer layer and a magnetic layer, were prepared with magnetic-layer compositions of Fe₈₀Co₁₀Al₈Zr₂, Fe₇₀Co₂₀Al₈Zr₂, Fe₆₀Co₃₀Al₈Zr₂, and Fe₄₅Co₄₅Al₈Zr₂, and characterised using X-ray and polarised neutron reflectometry. Across the series, the nuclear SLD of the FeCoAlZr alloy decreases approximately linearly from 7.14 × 10⁻⁶ to 4.63 × 10⁻⁶ mathringA⁻² with increasing Co content, while the magnetic SLD is approximately 4.3-4.5 × 10⁻⁶ mathringA⁻². These results demonstrate that the nuclear and magnetic contributions can be controlled largely independently, with composition primarily tuning the nuclear SLD and the applied magnetic field offering, in principle, additional control of the magnetic contribution.
full_list.abstract_zh: 可以故意设计样品的散射长度密度 (SLD) 分布，以增强从中子反射计获得的感兴趣信息。在这里，我们使用非晶 FeₓCoyAl₈Zr2 薄膜演示了这种方法。制备四个样品，每个样品包括十个重复的AlZr间隔层和磁性层，其磁性层组合物为Fe 80 Co 10 Al 8 Zr 2 、Fe 70 Co 20 Al 8 Zr 2 、Fe 60 Co 30 Al 8 Zr 2 和Fe 45 Co 45 Al 8 Zr 2 ，并且使用 X 射线和偏振中子反射计进行表征。

full_list.title_en: Discrete time liquids
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Discrete time liquids
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30266v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discrete time crystals exhibit robust subharmonic oscillations, spontaneously breaking the discrete time-translation symmetry of a periodic drive. Since their emergence, the question of whether other types of temporal many-body order can exist has attracted considerable attention. Here we identify discrete time liquids -- a new form of spatiotemporal order characterized by short-range temporal coherence as a result of time-solitons. We study a two-dimensional spin system coupled to a finite-temperature cavity, whose fluctuations provide a noisy, approximately periodic drive with only finite temporal coherence. Remarkably, the spins nevertheless form a metastable state with robust period-doubled dynamics over an extended parameter regime. Unlike a time crystal, this state has only finite temporal coherence: individual trajectories stochastically switch between the two symmetry-related temporal configurations of the period-doubled response. We identify these switches as time-solitons: topological defects in temporal order that preserve local period doubling while destroying long-range temporal coherence, thereby producing the time liquid state. We propose a minimal model which reproduces the distribution of temporal correlations of the many-body system, suggesting a general description of the time liquid as a time crystal with a finite density of time-solitons. Because these solitons can occur at arbitrary times, ensemble averaging restores continuous time-translation symmetry, raising the intriguing possibility that discrete time liquids can exist in thermal equilibrium.

full_list.title_en: Domain walls in R3c-structured NaNbO₃
full_list.title_zh: R3c 结构 NaNbO₃ 中的畴壁
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30318v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we undertake a systematic first-principles study of structural domain walls in the low-temperature rhombohedral R3c phase of perovskite oxide NaNbO₃. Employing a group-theoretic classification, we introduce eight unique classes of domain walls in the R3c structure, four of which have a domain wall orientation determined uniquely by the conditions of elastic compatibility and charge neutrality, and perform structural relaxations for each representative domain wall class. We find that one class of 109deg domain walls has a notably low energy of 9 mJ m⁻², comparable to the low-energy ferroelectric walls in BaTiO₃. Finally, we find that this class of 109deg walls is compatible with the crystal twinning observed in experiments on the R3c phase, and propose an atomistic mechanism for the R3c ↔ Pbcm phase transition.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在这项工作中，我们对钙钛矿氧化物NaNbO₃的低温菱形R3c相的结构畴壁进行了系统的第一性原理研究。采用群论分类，我们在 R3c 结构中引入了八种独特的畴壁类别，其中四种具有由弹性相容性和电荷中性条件唯一确定的畴壁方向，并对每个代表性的畴壁类别进行结构松弛。我们发现一类 109deg 畴壁的能量非常低，为 9 mJ m⁻²，与 BaTiO₃ 中的低能铁电壁相当。

full_list.title_en: Electronic Screening as a Design Lever in La-Doped BaTiO₃: Coupled Polarization, Dielectric Response, and Optical Anisotropy
full_list.title_zh: 电子筛选作为 La 掺杂 BaTiO₃ 的设计杠杆：耦合偏振、介电响应和光学各向异性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Donor substitution can tune the coupled ferroelectric, dielectric, electronic, and optical properties of perovskite oxides by modifying lattice distortions and electronic screening. We investigate these effects in La-doped BaTiO3 using density functional theory, density-functional perturbation theory, and the Berry-phase formalism for polarization. For a model with 12.5% La substitution at the Ba site, La incorporation induces anisotropic lattice contraction, reduces tetragonality and Ti off-centering, and weakens the energetic stabilization of the tetragonal ferroelectric phase. The accompanying reduction in polarization is associated with enhanced electronic screening and reduced anomalous Born effective charges. Phonon calculations indicate that the relaxed doped structure is dynamically stable, while hardening of a low-frequency polar mode is consistent with weakened ferroelectricity. The high-frequency dielectric response increases moderately, whereas the static dielectric response decreases as the lattice contribution is suppressed. Electronic-structure calculations show a Fermi-level shift toward the conduction band without mid-gap defect states. The optical spectra exhibit an absorption-edge shift consistent with a Burstein-Moss-type mechanism, enhanced near-edge transparency, and reduced birefringence. Together, these results suggest a microscopic connection between donor-induced screening, polar-mode hardening, reduced dynamical charges, polarization suppression, and decreased optical anisotropy. The conclusions apply to the investigated 12.5% composition; calculations at additional concentrations are needed to establish quantitative doping trends.
full_list.abstract_zh: 供体替代可以通过改变晶格畸变和电子屏蔽来调节钙钛矿氧化物的耦合铁电、介电、电子和光学特性。我们使用密度泛函理论、密度泛函微扰理论和极化的 Berry 相形式研究了 La 掺杂 BaTiO3 中的这些效应。对于 Ba 位点具有 12.5% La 取代的模型，La 的掺入会引起各向异性晶格收缩，降低四方性和 Ti 偏心，并削弱四方铁电相的能量稳定性。随之而来的极化减少与电子屏蔽的增强和异常玻恩有效电荷的减少有关。

full_list.title_en: Electrostatic edge effects versus edge doping in graphene nanoribbons: a scanning gate microscopy and modelling study
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electrostatic edge effects versus edge doping in graphene nanoribbons: a scanning gate microscopy and modelling study
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2602.12944v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The charge neutrality point (CNP) of graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) patterned by oxygen plasma etching moves towards zero as the ribbon narrows and, on 300 nm SiO2, changes sign below a crossover width of ~ 50 nm: an observation previously attributed to n-type edges surrounding a p-type bulk. We test this edge-doping hypothesis in three ways. First, finite element modelling of complete GNR transistors with uniform doping shows that fringing of the gate field at the edges reproduces the trend of the measured CNP with width down to ~ 50nm without any edge doping, while producing a bias-dependent inversion of the carrier type at the edges that mimics n-type edges in scanned-probe measurements. Second, fitting the CNP of ribbons on 90 nm and 300 nm SiO2 with the gate capacitance of a finite strip, which fixes the electrostatic contribution with no adjustable parameter other than the bulk doping, shows that fringing accounts for most of the width dependence and isolates the remainder as an edge charge. This is acceptor-like (0.24 e/nm per edge) in the present ribbons, which therefore have no n-type edges, and donor-like but small in devices on 300 nm SiO2; no single edge-charge, field-coupled or contact-doping mechanism describes both. Third, scanning gate microscopy finds no edge contrast of the sign expected for n-type edges. The width dependence of the CNP is therefore predominantly electrostatic, and n-type edges are not an intrinsic consequence of oxygen-plasma etching. A design map shows that fringing dominates the width dependence whenever the gate dielectric is thicker than 30-50 nm, whereas in scaled high-K transistors, edge charge dominates and would shift the threshold voltage of a 10 nm ribbon by ~ 0.1-0.15 V. Fitting the CNP versus width with the strip capacitance provides a simple test for edge doping in any gated two-dimensional nanostructure

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2507.02079v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quantum anomalies give rise to novel transport phenomena, including the generation of a current in a relativistic fluid due to the presence of magnetic field or vorticity. We present an exclusive and direct computation of the chiral anomaly in the adiabatic regime within the path integral for a massless fermion on a generic electromagnetic and curved background, including local temperature and chemical potential. We identify new quantum-thermodynamical contributions to the breaking of axial symmetry which induce the Chiral Separation and Vortical Effects.

full_list.title_en: Extreme competition between stripes and superconductivity in the hole-doped Hubbard model
full_list.title_zh: 空穴掺杂哈伯德模型中条纹与超导之间的极端竞争
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30321v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The two-dimensional Hubbard model was originally proposed as the minimal model of uniform d-wave superconductivity in the cuprate high-temperature superconductors, but recent calculations with relevant parameters in a realistic doping regime have often found other ground states. Further, uncertainty remains over such results due to the intrinsic bias of different computational methods. Here we address this uncertainty through state-of-the-art neural tensor network and neural backflow state simulations, enabled by large-scale GPU computation, that together reach an unprecedented variational accuracy on lattices with up to 1024 sites. At 1/8 doping in the pure Hubbard model, as well as with next-nearest-neighbor hopping relevant to the hole-doped cuprates, we reveal a near degeneracy among a low-energy uniform d-wave state, superconducting stripes, and non-superconducting stripe states on the milli-t energy scale. Our work rebalances the narrative that the Hubbard model supports a single dominant order in relevant parameter regimes towards a picture of extreme competition between stripes and superconductivity.

full_list.title_en: Field-free superconducting diode and tunable vortex dynamics in NbN/FePt stripe-domain heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: NbN/FePt 条带域异质结构中的无场超导二极管和可调谐涡旋动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate reconfigurable, field-free superconducting diode behavior in NbN/FePt and NbN/AlN/FePt heterostructures with remanent stripe domains in the FePt layer. NbN films 10 nm thick are capped either directly with FePt or through a thin AlN spacer, which reduces electronic proximity effects while preserving magnetic coupling through stray fields. At zero applied magnetic field, the superconducting diode efficiency reaches approximately 50--60% in NbN/FePt when the stripes are perpendicular to the current and is strongly reduced when they are parallel. The diode effect persists in NbN/AlN/FePt with efficiencies reaching approximately 35--40%, supporting a magnetic origin of the nonreciprocity. We interpret the response as asymmetric vortex transport in the remanent magnetic landscape, with preferential edge vorticity and a Lorentz force that favors inward flux injection or outward motion depending on current polarity. Under applied perpendicular magnetic fields, the interplay between the external field and the magnetic stray fields modifies the flux-flow instability and the apparent instability velocity inferred from transport, with values below those reported for bare NbN films. These results show that stripe-domain ferromagnetic overlayers provide a reconfigurable route to control superconducting nonreciprocity and flux-flow stability in NbN-based heterostructures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们展示了 NbN/FePt 和 NbN/AlN/FePt 异质结构中的可重构、无场超导二极管行为，并在 FePt 层中具有剩余条带域。 10 nm 厚的 NbN 薄膜直接用 FePt 覆盖或通过薄的 AlN 间隔物覆盖，这减少了电子邻近效应，同时保持通过杂散场的磁耦合。在零外加磁场下，当条带垂直于电流时，NbN/FePt 中的超导二极管效率达到约 50--60%，而当条带平行时，效率会大大降低。

full_list.title_en: Fluctuation-free Quantum Battery Charging Enabled by Bell-like Entangled and Separable Charger States
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Fluctuation-free Quantum Battery Charging Enabled by Bell-like Entangled and Separable Charger States
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31242v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The implication of entanglement in quantum battery charging remains poorly understood. In addition, intrinsic quantum randomness poses a fundamental challenge to charging uniformity across distinct trials. To address these issues, we study a three-qubit system within a cascaded collision frame, with two qubits acting as the charger and the third serving as the battery. After each collision, an adaptive measurement is performed on the charger, yielding four conditional post-measurement battery states with identical expected stored energy. For arbitrary fixed charger states, we derive analytical expressions for the recurrence relation of stored energy. We find that stored-energy fluctuations depend on whether the dynamics relies on the battery phase (γₙ). For two Bell-like families of entangled states, together with their computational basis states termed Bell-like separable states, the dynamics is (γₙ)-independent and fluctuations vanish, whereas for other entangled and separable states, fluctuations emerge. These insights establish a paradigm for engineering charger states to design uniform-charging quantum-battery architectures despite inherent quantum randomness.

full_list.title_en: Impact of localized 4f magnetism on Berry curvature and the intrinsic anomalous Hall effect in CeRu₂Si₂
full_list.title_zh: 局域 4f 磁力对贝里曲率的影响以及 CeRu2Si2 中固有的反常霍尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The intrinsic anomalous Hall effect (AHE), originating from Berry curvature, has been extensively studied in f-electron systems, including Ce-based compounds. However, how the magnetism of localized f electrons affect the intrinsic AHE remains unclear. Here, we investigate this issue in CeRu₂Si₂ by calculating the intrinsic anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) for several occupied Ce-4f states using first-principles LDA+U calculations combined with Wannier interpolation method. We find that the intrinsic AHC remains finite even when the Ce-4f states are localized and do not contribute directly to the Fermi surface, and that its magnitude depends on which Ce-4f state is occupied. We show that localized 4f-electron magnetism induces exchange splitting in the conduction bands, generating Berry curvature in specific regions near the Fermi surface. This mechanism enables conduction bands that are derived from nonmagnetic orbitals and form the Fermi surface to contribute to the intrinsic AHE, suggesting a route to realizing large intrinsic AHE in f-electron materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 源自贝里曲率的本征反常霍尔效应 (AHE) 已在 f 电子系统（包括 Ce 基化合物）中得到广泛研究。然而，局域 f 电子的磁性如何影响本征 AHE 仍不清楚。在这里，我们通过使用第一性原理 LDA+U 计算结合 Wannier 插值法计算几个占据的 Ce-4f 态的本征反常霍尔电导率 (AHC)，研究了 CeRu2Si2 中的这个问题。我们发现，即使 Ce-4f 态局域化并且不直接影响费米面，本征 AHC 仍然是有限的，并且其大小取决于占据哪个 Ce-4f 态。

full_list.title_en: Kondo screening and random-singlet formation in highly disordered systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Kondo screening and random-singlet formation in highly disordered systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.19389v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a minimal effective framework designed to address the anomalous low-temperature thermodynamics observed in strongly disordered interacting systems near a metal-insulator transition, such as doped semiconductors. Our approach examines how a strongly inhomogeneous electronic bath quenches dilute pairs of local magnetic moments. By solving the resulting two-impurity Kondo-Heisenberg problem within a large-N variational framework, we capture the competition between Kondo screening and random-singlet formation. Both mechanisms give rise to singular thermodynamic responses, producing a magnetic susceptibility of the form χ(T)sim T⁻α, where the exponent α evolves smoothly with model parameters and saturates in the metallic regime, consistent with experimental observations. Our results establish a unified framework that connects random-singlet physics and disorder-induced Kondo screening in strongly disordered correlated materials.

full_list.title_en: Maxwell-Chern-Simons-Matter in AdS₃
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Maxwell-Chern-Simons-Matter in AdS₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30260v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study Maxwell-Chern-Simons theory on AdS₃ coupled to N complex scalars or Dirac fermions, including sextic and Gross-Neveu interactions, respectively. First, we derive the bulk Maxwell-Chern-Simons propagator, clarifying how Dirichlet boundary conditions fix the contributions of the massive and flat sectors. Upon coupling to the matter sector, we work at large N with κ=k/N and α=Ne² fixed, where k is the Chern-Simons level. We determine the corresponding phase diagrams, and we resum matter insertions to obtain the photon propagator at leading order in large N, exactly in α and κ. Its poles determine the spin-one boundary spectrum, split into two helicity sectors by the Chern-Simons interaction. With Dirichlet boundary conditions, the unHiggsed scalar phase contains a protected chiral current, which is lifted by Higgsing. In the fermionic phases, the current persists for nonzero effective Chern-Simons level, with helicity determined by the induced level shift. At bulk conformal points, we extract large-N BCFT data for the critical and tricritical scalar theories, as well as for the regular fermion and Gross-Neveu theories.

full_list.title_en: Monodromy Defects of 3D Wilson-Fisher Criticality on the Fuzzy Sphere
full_list.title_zh: 模糊球上3D Wilson-Fisher临界值的单向缺陷
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.31269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Monodromy (twist) line defects arise as the boundaries of topological symmetry surfaces, which are among the simplest non-trivial conformal defects with direct realizations as magnetic vortex in quantum magnets, as Wilson and t Hooft lines of gauge theories, and as the replica twist operators in quantum information theory. However, their interacting dynamics remains difficult to characterize non-perturbatively. Here we design a way to realize the monodromy boundary conditions in the fuzzy-sphere regularization by threading a symmetry-selective Aharonov-Bohm flux through the two poles of the sphere. We apply this construction to the Z₂ twist of the 3D Ising conformal field theory (CFT), π-twist of the 3D O(2) CFT and three inequivalent monodromies of O(3) (centre twist, z-axis π-twist and the reflection). For each defect, we extract the low-lying defect spectrum together with bulk-to-defect and defect-defect operator product expansion coefficients, which characterize the operators living on the defect line, their mutual interactions, and how they couple to the surrounding critical bulk. Among the low-lying defect primaries resolved in our spectra, we find no relevant scalar perturbation that preserves all the symmetries of the corresponding defect. The relevant deformations identified in our calculations break at least one preserved symmetry, providing evidence that these monodromy defects are stable against symmetry-preserving relevant perturbations. These results establish a systematic set of non-perturbative conformal data for monodromy defects beyond the Ising twist. Our construction therefore turns the symmetry flux into a tunable knob of the fuzzy-sphere regularization, opening a route to exploring the response of critical matter to distinct defects.
full_list.abstract_zh: 单向（扭曲）线缺陷作为拓扑对称面的边界出现，是最简单的非平凡共形缺陷之一，可以直接实现为量子磁体中的磁涡流、规范理论中的威尔逊线和霍夫特线以及量子信息论中的复制扭曲算子。然而，它们的相互作用动态仍然难以非扰动地表征。在这里，我们设计了一种通过将对称选择性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量穿过球体的两个极点来实现模糊球正则化中的单向边界条件的方法。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 单向（扭曲）线缺陷作为拓扑对称面的边界出现，是最简单的非平凡共形缺陷之一，可以直接实现为量子磁体中的磁涡流、规范理论中的威尔逊线和霍夫特线以及量子信息论中的复制扭曲算子。然而，它们的相互作用动态仍然难以非扰动地表征。在这里，我们设计了一种通过将对称选择性阿哈罗诺夫-玻姆通量穿过球体的两个极点来实现模糊球正则化中的单向边界条件的方法。我们将此构造应用于 3D 伊辛共形场论 (CFT) 的 Z2 扭曲、3D O(2) CFT 的 π 扭曲和 O(3) 的三个不等价单峰（中心扭曲、z 轴 π 扭曲和反射）。对于每个缺陷，我们提取低位缺陷谱以及块体到缺陷和缺陷到缺陷算子乘积展开系数，这些系数描述了缺陷线上的算子、它们的相互作用以及它们如何与周围的临界块体耦合。在我们的光谱中解析的低位缺陷原色中，我们没有发现相关的标量扰动可以保留相应缺陷的所有对称性。我们的计算中确定的相关变形破坏了至少一种保留的对称性，提供了证据表明这些单向缺陷对于保留对称性的相关扰动是稳定的。这些结果为伊辛扭曲之外的单峰缺陷建立了一组系统的非微扰共形数据。因此，我们的构造将对称通量转变为模糊球正则化的可调旋钮，开辟了一条探索关键物质对不同缺陷的响应的途径。

full_list.title_en: Nonlinear and Chaotic Dynamics of Two Dipolar-Coupled Anisotropic Spins under Periodic Excitation
full_list.title_zh: 周期性激励下两个偶极耦合各向异性自旋的非线性和混沌动力学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30414v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the non-linear magnetization dynamics of two identical anisotropic macrospins coupled by dipolar interaction and subjected to periodic transverse excitation. The coupled Landau- Lifshitz-Gilbert equations are solved numerically using a fourth-order Runge-Kutta method. By combining bifurcation diagrams, local-maxima analysis, Lyapunov exponents, and two-dimensional stability maps, we characterize how dipolar coupling, transverse driving amplitudes, and uniaxial anisotropy govern the long-time dynamics. The results reveal a non-monotonic reorganization of dynamical regimes, with alternating intervals of enhanced and suppressed instability. Analysis of symmetric and antisymmetric coordinates distinguishes the collective and relative spin responses, while Fourier spectra and three-dimensional trajectories provide complementary frequency-domain and geometrical characterizations. Simultaneous positivity of the two largest Lyapunov exponents identifies parameter regions consistent with hyperchaotic dynamics. Finally, analytical linearization and ferromagnetic-resonance calculations reveal the distinct coupling dependence of the collectivemode frequencies and clarify the limitations of the linearized description beyond the stability thresholds of the collinear reference state. These findings establish a unified framework for understanding the interplay of dipolar coupling, anisotropy, and periodic excitation in the non-linear dynamics of a minimal interacting-spin system.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了两个相同的各向异性宏自旋通过偶极相互作用耦合并受到周期性横向激励的非线性磁化动力学。使用四阶龙格-库塔方法对耦合的 Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert 方程进行数值求解。通过结合分岔图、局部最大值分析、Lyapunov 指数和二维稳定性图，我们描述了偶极耦合、横向驱动振幅和单轴各向异性如何控制长期动力学。结果揭示了动态状态的非单调重组，具有增强和抑制不稳定性的交替间隔。

full_list.title_en: Spin polarization in a chiral ladder: elastic and inelastic environments
full_list.title_zh: 手性阶梯中的自旋极化：弹性和非弹性环境
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30419v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how the transport window and environmental reinjection determine the spin polarization transmitted through a minimal two-leg chiral ladder. The model contains time-reversal-invariant helical spin--orbit coupling, spin-independent interchain hopping, and nonmagnetic contacts with two orbital modes per lead. Sublattice symmetry makes the coherent spin-transmission kernel exactly odd in energy. A window centered on the symmetry point therefore gives zero integrated spin current, whereas a displaced window selects an uncanceled spectral interval. The resulting polarization reverses between enantiomers and vanishes in the decoupled-chain, zero-spin--orbit, and equivalent-strand limits of this model. We compare uniform absorption, energy-resolved elastic probes, and thermalized voltage probes at the same finite bias, including reinjection whenever probes are present. Charge conservation alone does not prohibit enhancement of the integrated spin signal: the elastic-probe response can increase at finite bias even where its linear-response counterpart decreases. Thermalized probes can also lift the centered-window zero that elastic probes preserve. Absorption and reinjection also change the transmitted charge, so enhancement of spin current and enhancement of normalized polarization must be distinguished. Static onsite disorder produces sample-dependent fluctuations; its signed ensemble mean is reported with uncertainty and is not forced to vanish in a displaced window. These results identify the energy interval and reservoir prescription that must be controlled when interpreting dephasing trends in minimal models relevant to chirality-induced spin selectivity.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了传输窗口和环境再注入如何确定通过最小两腿手性梯传输的自旋极化。该模型包含时间反转不变的螺旋自旋轨道耦合、自旋无关的链间跳跃以及每导联具有两种轨道模式的非磁性接触。亚晶格对称性使得相干自旋传输核的能量恰好为奇数。因此，以对称点为中心的窗口给出零积分自旋电流，而移位的窗口选择未消除的光谱间隔。由此产生的极化在对映体之间反转，并在该模型的解耦链、零自旋轨道和等效链极限中消失。我们在相同的有限偏置下比较均匀吸收、能量分辨弹性探针和热化电压探针，包括探针存在时的重新注入。

full_list.title_en: String Order in Quench Dynamics as a Probe of Quantum Phase Transitions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：String Order in Quench Dynamics as a Probe of Quantum Phase Transitions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30647v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the anisotropic XY chain in a transverse field by introducing a global string order parameter and examining its equilibrium behavior and its quench dynamics from a fully polarized initial state. The corresponding string operator is defined as the product of local projected spin operators over the entire chain. The nonequilibrium order parameter is the long-time average of the logarithm of the string-operator expectation value per site after the quench.For the ground state, its field derivative is singular on the Ising critical lines; after the quench, the steady-state response also records the field boundaries and the anisotropy transition. We derive analytically the nonanalytic behavior of the order parameter at the quantum critical lines. Our results reveal a hidden nonlocal order underlying this paradigmatic model of conventional quantum phase transitions. They also connect measurable spin populations with equilibrium and dynamical topological structure.

full_list.title_en: Supercoiling Drives DNA-Protein Co-Condensation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Supercoiling Drives DNA-Protein Co-Condensation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30588v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The co-condensation of DNA and proteins plays an important role in genome compaction, including heterochromatin formation and chromosome segregation. Meanwhile, transcription and replication continuously generate DNA supercoiling, yet how the resulting torsional stress affects co-condensation remains poorly understood. Here, by coupling DNA elasticity to a protein concentration field, we show that supercoiling acts as a topological catalyst for co-condensation through a mutually reinforcing interplay with protein wetting. Specifically, protein wetting facilitates twist-to-writhe conversion, generating highly writhed DNA conformations that in turn promote capillary collapse into a protein-rich droplet. In the absence of supercoiling, DNA remains kinetically trapped in metastable extended states within our model, whereas sufficiently strong supercoiling removes the nucleation barrier and enables spontaneous co-condensation. These results establish topology as a distinct control parameter for biomolecular condensation and provide a mechanical framework for how active genomic processes can dynamically regulate large-scale genome organization.

full_list.title_en: Symmetry-Preserving Local Representation for Short-Range Interaction in Complex Materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Symmetry-Preserving Local Representation for Short-Range Interaction in Complex Materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.30726v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modeling short-range interactions in highly disordered materials remains challenging due to the immense configuration space and the disruption of local symmetry in truncated theoretical models. Here, we propose a symmetry-preserving local representation framework that strictly enforces topological continuity and translational invariance via boundary passivation. Applied to high-entropy alloys, this approach autonomously unravels the nonlinear ligand effects modulating local reactivity and accurately captures coverage-dependent many-body interactions without explicit periodic expansion. By resolving the conflict between localized chemical environments and extended periodic boundaries, this framework not only reduces computational complexity by an order of magnitude but also provides a physically transparent paradigm for deciphering short-range order in complex condensed matter systems.

core_items.title_en: Exact few-magnon Bethe scars of the non-integrable alternating Heisenberg chain
core_items.title_zh: 不可积交替海森堡链的精确少磁振子贝特疤痕
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2501.14017v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Exact solutions of quantum lattice models serve as useful guides for interpreting physical phenomena in condensed matter systems. Prominent examples of integrability appear in one dimension, including the Heisenberg chain, where the Bethe ansatz method has been widely successful. Recent work has noted that certain non-integrable models harbor quantum many-body scar states, which form a superspin of regular states hidden in an otherwise chaotic spectrum. Here we consider one of the simplest examples of a non-integrable model, the alternating ferromagnetic-antiferromagnetic (bond-staggered) Heisenberg chain, a close cousin of the spin-1 Haldane chain and a spin analog of the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger model, and show the presence of exponentially many zero-energy states. We highlight features of the alternating chain that allow treatment with the coordinate Bethe ansatz (with important modifications), and surprisingly, for a non-integrable system, we find simple compact expressions for zero-energy eigenfunctions for a few magnons, including solutions with fractionalized particle momentum. These states exhibit wavefunction scarring similar to that of single-particle states in chaotic billiards. We discuss a general numerical recipe to diagnose the existence of such generalized Bethe ansatz (GBA) scar states and also provide exact analytic expressions for their entanglement. We conclude by conjecturing a picture of magnon pairing which may generalize to multiple magnons. Our work opens the avenue to describe certain eigenstates of partially integrable systems using the GBA.
core_items.abstract_zh: 量子晶格模型的精确解可以为解释凝聚态物质系统中的物理现象提供有用的指导。可积性的突出例子出现在一维，包括海森堡链，其中 Bethe ansatz 方法取得了广泛的成功。最近的研究指出，某些不可积模型具有量子多体疤痕态，这些态形成隐藏在混沌光谱中的规则态的超自旋。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 量子晶格模型的精确解可以为解释凝聚态物质系统中的物理现象提供有用的指导。可积性的突出例子出现在一维，包括海森堡链，其中 Bethe ansatz 方法取得了广泛的成功。最近的研究指出，某些不可积模型具有量子多体疤痕态，这些态形成隐藏在混沌光谱中的规则态的超自旋。在这里，我们考虑不可积模型最简单的例子之一，即交替的铁磁-反铁磁（键交错）海森堡链，它是自旋 1 Haldane 链的近亲，也是 Su-Schrieffer-Heeger 模型的自旋类似物，并显示了指数级许多零能态的存在。我们强调了交替链的特征，这些特征允许用坐标 Bethe ansatz 进行处理（经过重要修改），令人惊讶的是，对于不可积系统，我们找到了一些磁振子的零能量本征函数的简单紧凑表达式，包括具有分数化粒子动量的解。这些状态表现出与混沌台球中的单粒子状态相似的波函数疤痕。我们讨论了诊断此类广义 Bethe ansatz (GBA) 疤痕态是否存在的通用数值方法，并为其纠缠提供了精确的分析表达式。我们通过推测磁振子配对图来得出结论，该图可以推广到多个磁振子。我们的工作为使用 GBA 描述部分可积系统的某些本征态开辟了道路。

core_items.title_en: Interaction-enhanced antiferromagnetic correlations in a Kondo ladder with a gapped band structure
core_items.title_zh: 具有带隙结构的近藤梯中相互作用增强的反铁磁相关性
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.31142v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate magnetic correlations in the two-leg Kondo-Hubbard ladder using the density-matrix renormalization group method. We focus on a parameter regime in which the noninteracting electronic system has a narrow indirect band gap. In this regime, there is no Fermi surface, and the conventional Fermi-surface-based Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida picture is not directly applicable; magnetic correlations between localized spins become weaker as the noninteracting band gap increases. We find that a moderate on-site Coulomb interaction enhances the antiferromagnetic correlations between localized spins. This enhancement, which is also seen in the staggered magnetization induced by a pinning field at the edges, occurs for both ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic Kondo couplings. Our results show that electron-electron interactions can enhance magnetic correlations between localized spins even when the underlying noninteracting electronic structure is gapped, suggesting an interaction-driven route to magnetic instabilities in narrow-gap Kondo-lattice systems.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们使用密度矩阵重整化群方法研究两腿 Kondo-Hubbard 梯中的磁相关性。我们重点关注非相互作用电子系统具有窄间接带隙的参数范围。在这个体系中，不存在费米面，传统的基于费米面的Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida图不能直接适用；随着非相互作用带隙的增加，局部自旋之间的磁相关性变得更弱。我们发现适度的现场库仑相互作用增强了局部自旋之间的反铁磁相关性。这种增强在铁磁和反铁磁近藤耦合中都会出现，在边缘钉扎场引起的交错磁化强度中也可以看到。

core_items.title_en: Quantum geometry and quantum capacitance in the orbital magneto-electric effect
core_items.title_zh: 轨道磁电效应中的量子几何和量子电容
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2505.02911v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The orbital magneto-electric effect (OME), the generation of a steady-state orbital angular momentum (OAM) density by an electric field, is a central component of orbitronics. Nevertheless its microscopic interpretation is complicated by the existence of two qualitatively different contributions: the intra-band Edelstein term stemming from the combined effect of the equilibrium OAM and Fermi surface shift, and the inter-band contribution, stemming from Zitterbewegung induced by the electric field. Here we develop a pedagogical density-matrix formulation of the OME within the framework of the modern theory of Bloch-electron OAM, in which the two contributions naturally emerge from distinct parts of the density matrix, and their distinct quantum geometric structures are clearly seen. In the inter-band contribution, in addition to the local- and itinerant-circulation terms, we show that a band-diagonal displacement, or charge dipole, is present, which is linear in the electric field and governed by the normalized quantum metric. For a tilted massive Dirac cone the Zitterbewegung OME and the Fermi-surface orbital response occur for orthogonal electric-field orientations, providing a route to separate them experimentally. The itinerant-circulation contribution is identical to the dipolar one, so in a two-band model the dipole accounts for exactly half of the inter-band response, both in the doped regime and in the insulating gap. Our recent insights identify quantum-metric engineering as a route for enhancing orbital magneto-electric responses and clarify the relation between modern orbital magnetization, polarization, and orbital torque phenomenology.
core_items.abstract_zh: 轨道磁电效应（OME），即通过电场产生稳态轨道角动量（OAM）密度，是轨道电子学的核心组成部分。然而，它的微观解释由于存在两种性质不同的贡献而变得复杂：带内埃德尔斯坦项源于平衡OAM和费米表面位移的综合效应，以及带间贡献源于电场引起的Zitterbewegung。在这里，我们在布洛赫电子 OAM 的现代理论框架内开发了 OME 的教学密度矩阵公式，其中两个贡献自然地从密度矩阵的不同部分中出现，并且可以清楚地看到它们不同的量子几何结构。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 轨道磁电效应（OME），即通过电场产生稳态轨道角动量（OAM）密度，是轨道电子学的核心组成部分。然而，它的微观解释由于存在两种性质不同的贡献而变得复杂：带内埃德尔斯坦项源于平衡OAM和费米表面位移的综合效应，以及带间贡献源于电场引起的Zitterbewegung。在这里，我们在布洛赫电子 OAM 的现代理论框架内开发了 OME 的教学密度矩阵公式，其中两个贡献自然地从密度矩阵的不同部分中出现，并且可以清楚地看到它们不同的量子几何结构。在带间贡献中，除了局域环流项和巡回环流项之外，我们还表明存在带对角线位移或电荷偶极子，它在电场中是线性的，并由归一化量子度量控制。对于倾斜的大狄拉克锥体，Zitterbewegung OME 和费米表面轨道响应会在正交电场方向上发生，从而提供了在实验上分离它们的途径。巡回循环的贡献与偶极子的贡献相同，因此在双带模型中，偶极子恰好占带间响应的一半，无论是在掺杂状态还是在绝缘间隙中。我们最近的见解将量子计量工程确定为增强轨道磁电响应的途径，并阐明现代轨道磁化、极化和轨道扭矩现象学之间的关系。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《轨道磁电效应中的量子几何和量子电容》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: π-Flux Tuning of Quantum Paramagnetism in the Triangular-Lattice Hubbard Model
core_items.title_zh: 三角晶格哈伯德模型中量子顺磁性的 π 通量调谐
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.30290v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We compare two time-reversal-symmetric triangular-lattice Hubbard models at half filling: the zero-flux model and a staggered π-flux model with zero and π flux through oppositely oriented triangles. Although both reduce to the same Heisenberg model at leading order in the strong-coupling limit, their distinct charge fluctuation profiles yield different quantum paramagnetic regimes. Combining a strong-coupling expansion with infinite density matrix renormalization group (iDMRG) calculations, we find that the positive ring-exchange of the zero-flux model promotes spontaneous chirality, consistent with its notion of a chiral spin liquid at intermediate coupling. In the staggered-π-flux model, whose noninteracting limit is a Dirac semimetal, the ring exchange changes sign and disfavors chiral order and we find no resolvable scalar chirality. This renders flux-tuned ring-exchange an efficient discriminator between chiral and non-chiral quantum paramagnets at finite coupling.
core_items.abstract_zh: 我们比较了半填充时的两个时间反转对称三角晶格哈伯德模型：零通量模型和交错 π 通量模型，其中零通量和 π 通量穿过相反方向的三角形。尽管两者在强耦合极限的前导阶上都简化为相同的海森堡模型，但它们不同的电荷涨落曲线产生了不同的量子顺磁状态。将强耦合展开式与无限密度矩阵重正化群（iDMRG）计算相结合，我们发现零通量模型的正环交换促进了自发手性，与其中间耦合时手性自旋液体的概念一致。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 我们比较了半填充时的两个时间反转对称三角晶格哈伯德模型：零通量模型和交错 π 通量模型，其中零通量和 π 通量穿过相反方向的三角形。尽管两者在强耦合极限的前导阶上都简化为相同的海森堡模型，但它们不同的电荷涨落曲线产生了不同的量子顺磁状态。将强耦合展开式与无限密度矩阵重正化群（iDMRG）计算相结合，我们发现零通量模型的正环交换促进了自发手性，与其中间耦合时手性自旋液体的概念一致。在交错π通量模型中，其非相互作用极限是狄拉克半金属，环交换改变了符号并且不利于手性顺序，并且我们发现没有可解析的标量手性。这使得通量调谐环交换成为有限耦合下手性和非手性量子顺磁体之间的有效鉴别器。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

core_items.title_en: Thermal expansion mechanisms, heat transport, and band-gap renormalization in strongly anharmonic Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ from machine-learned interatomic potentials
core_items.title_zh: 根据机器学习的原子间势研究强非谐 Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba₃Lu(BO3)3 的热膨胀机制、热传输和带隙重正化
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.30918v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ are structurally complex materials whose thermal expansion has been interpreted, on the basis of high-temperature x-ray diffraction, in terms of specific polyhedral rearrangements. We study their lattice dynamics and its consequences for thermal and electronic properties using molecular dynamics with actively learned moment tensor potentials trained on density-functional theory data. The anharmonicity measure σ^A (compares the anharmonic contribution to the interatomic forces with the total forces acting on atoms) reaches approx0.3-0.5 for β-Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ and approx0.75 for orientationally disordered α-Rb₂SO₄, and the imaginary harmonic modes of Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃ and α-Rb₂SO₄ are stabilized at finite temperature. The simulations reproduce the measured thermal expansion and support the mechanisms proposed from diffraction: expansion along c in β-Rb₂SO₄ arises from both elongation and straightening of corrugated Rb chains, BO₃ reorientation accompanies the anisotropic expansion of Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃, and bending of polyhedral linkages limits expansion along the weakly expanding directions and in cubic Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃. Green-Kubo lattice thermal conductivities differ by more than an order of magnitude between compounds with comparable σ^A, showing that the anharmonicity measure alone does not determine heat transport. Phonon-induced band-gap renormalization, including lattice thermal expansion, reaches 2.7 and 1.7 eV at 1250 K in Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃ and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃ and 1.4 eV at 650 K in β-Rb₂SO₄, with zero-point renormalizations of 0.64, 0.70, and 0.31 eV for β-Rb₂SO₄, Rb₂Ca₂(SO₄)₃, and Ba₃Lu(BO₃)₃, respectively.
core_items.abstract_zh: Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 是结构复杂的材料，其热膨胀已在高温 X 射线衍射的基础上根据特定的多面体重排进行了解释。我们使用分子动力学研究它们的晶格动力学及其对热和电子性质的影响，并使用密度泛函理论数据训练的主动学习矩张量势。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 是结构复杂的材料，其热膨胀已在高温 X 射线衍射的基础上根据特定的多面体重排进行了解释。我们使用分子动力学研究它们的晶格动力学及其对热和电子性质的影响，并使用密度泛函理论数据训练的主动学习矩张量势。对于 β-Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba₃Lu(BO3)3，非谐性测度 σ^A（将原子间作用力的非谐性贡献与作用在原子上的总力进行比较）达到约 0.3-0.5，对于取向无序的 α-Rb2SO4，非谐性测度约为 0.75，虚部谐波模式为Rb2Ca2(SO4)3和α-Rb2SO4在有限温度下稳定。模拟再现了测得的热膨胀并支持衍射提出的机制：β-Rb2SO4中沿c的膨胀是由波纹Rb链的伸长和拉直引起的，BO3重新取向伴随着Ba3Lu(BO3)3的各向异性膨胀，多面体连接的弯曲限制了沿弱膨胀方向和立方体Rb2Ca2(SO4)3的膨胀。 Green-Kubo 晶格热导率在具有可比 σ^A 的化合物之间相差超过一个数量级，这表明非谐性测量本身并不能决定热传输。声子引起的带隙重整化（包括晶格热膨胀）在 Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 中在 1250 K 下达到 2.7 和 1.7 eV，在 β-Rb2SO4 中在 650 K 下达到 1.4 eV，零点重整化分别为 0.64、0.70 和β-Rb2SO4、Rb2Ca2(SO4)3 和 Ba3Lu(BO3)3 分别为 0.31 eV。

core_items.title_en: How good are universal MLIPs for alloys? A benchmark is only as trustworthy as its controls
core_items.title_zh: 适用于合金的通用 MLIP 效果如何？基准仅与其控制一样值得信赖
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.30641v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Universal machine-learned interatomic potentials (uMLIPs) are ranked by their formation-energy error against a DFT database, as if that database were ground truth, but independent DFT databases disagree. We benchmark fourteen uMLIPs on 1.45 million ordered intermetallics against AFLOW, which none trained on, and compare every energy and stability error with that disagreement. For half the structures, AFLOW, Alexandria, and OQMD differ by less than 6-8 meV/atom, but a minority differ by far more, raising the average to 16-30. That disagreement sets a floor on any model's measurable error. Re-referenced, the best uMLIP agrees with AFLOW as closely as Alexandria does, and the next four sit 2-7 meV/atom above the floor. Once broken elemental references are screened, the energy and stability rankings agree almost everywhere. Three apparent model failures shrink or vanish under the right control: poorly correlated shear moduli, thousands of "bad" DFT references, and the leader's inflated lead.
